stem: Best guess: which title is appropriate for cash-basis financial statements?

choices.text: Statement of Assets and Liabilities Arising from Cash Transactions
choices.explanation: Correct. Special purpose statements use titles that don't suggest GAAP.

explanation: Special purpose statements use titles that don't suggest GAAP.

stem: Which special purpose framework report generally requires a restriction on use?

choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 800: reports on contractual-basis statements (and regulatory-basis ones not intended for general use) include an other-matter paragraph restricting use.
Only regulatory and contractual bases generally.

explanation: AU-C 800: reports on contractual-basis statements (and regulatory-basis ones not intended for general use) include an other-matter paragraph restricting use.

stem: Last year's statements were audited by a predecessor whose report isn't reissued. What does this year's report include?

choices.text: An other-matter paragraph describing the predecessor's audit and opinion
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 700: an other-matter paragraph states the prior period was audited by a predecessor, the date and type of opinion, and reasons for any modification.
The prior-year audit must be described.
The auditor didn't audit the prior year.
The matter isn't in the statements.

explanation: AU-C 700: an other-matter paragraph states the prior period was audited by a predecessor, the date and type of opinion, and reasons for any modification.

stem: Which basis is a special purpose framework?

choices.explanation: Correct. Special purpose frameworks: cash, tax, regulatory, contractual, and other bases.

explanation: Special purpose frameworks: cash, tax, regulatory, contractual, and other bases.

stem: In an audit of tax-basis statements, which paragraph is required?

choices.text: An emphasis-of-matter paragraph alerting users to the basis of accounting
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 800 requires an emphasis-of-matter paragraph describing the framework.

explanation: AU-C 800 requires an emphasis-of-matter paragraph describing the framework.

stem: An auditor is engaged to audit only the rental revenue of a retail tenant for a landlord. How is materiality determined?

choices.text: Based on the tenant's total financial statements

choices.explanation: The landlord's statements aren't the subject.
Materiality applies to element audits too.

choices.text: In relation to the rental revenue element
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 805: materiality is determined for the specific element being reported on.

explanation: AU-C 805: materiality is determined for the specific element being reported on.

stem: A lender asks the auditor to report on compliance with loan covenants. What assurance is provided?

choices.text: Negative assurance, given in connection with the audit
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 806: "nothing came to our attention that caused us to believe the Company failed to comply…" — only if the auditor audited the statements.

explanation: AU-C 806: "nothing came to our attention that caused us to believe the Company failed to comply…" — only if the auditor audited the statements.

stem: The prior-year statements were reviewed, not audited. What does the current-year audit report include?

choices.explanation: The level of service must be described.

choices.text: An other-matter paragraph describing the review and stating no audit opinion is expressed on the prior year
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 700: an other-matter paragraph describes the prior-period service.

choices.text: A disclaimer on the current year
choices.explanation: The prior-year review is no basis for a disclaimer.

explanation: AU-C 700: an other-matter paragraph describes the prior-period service.

stem: This year, the auditor learns that last year's statements (on which it issued a qualified opinion) have been restated to correct the departure. What does the report include?

choices.explanation: The updated opinion should reflect the restatement.

choices.text: No mention of the prior year
A disclaimer on the prior year
choices.explanation: There's no basis for a disclaimer.

choices.text: An updated unmodified opinion on the prior year with an other-matter paragraph explaining the change
choices.explanation: Correct. When the updated opinion differs from the prior one, an other-matter paragraph discloses the date and type of the previous opinion, the reasons, and that the updated opinion differs.

explanation: When the updated opinion differs from the prior one, an other-matter paragraph discloses the date and type of the previous opinion, the reasons, and that the updated opinion differs.

stem: A comfort letter is addressed to whom?

choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 920: letters for underwriters are addressed to the underwriters and the entity.

explanation: AU-C 920: letters for underwriters are addressed to the underwriters and the entity.

stem: Which statement title is appropriate for regulatory-basis statements of an insurance company?

choices.text: Statement of Admitted Assets, Liabilities, and Capital and Surplus — Statutory Basis
choices.explanation: Correct. Titles should reflect the framework and avoid implying GAAP.

explanation: Titles should reflect the framework and avoid implying GAAP.

stem: A review of interim financial information under AU-C 930 is performed by whom and provides what?

choices.explanation: It's by the entity's annual auditor and gives limited assurance.

choices.text: The entity's annual auditor; limited assurance based mainly on inquiry and analytics
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 930 applies when the auditor of the annual statements reviews interim information.

choices.text: The entity's internal auditors; no assurance

explanation: AU-C 930 applies when the auditor of the annual statements reviews interim information.

stem: An auditor reports on statements prepared on the cash basis. Which wording belongs in the opinion?

choices.text: "…in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America"
choices.explanation: The statements aren't prepared under GAAP.

choices.text: "…in accordance with the cash basis of accounting described in Note 1"
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 800: the opinion refers to the applicable special purpose framework.

choices.text: "…in accordance with the income tax basis"

explanation: AU-C 800: the opinion refers to the applicable special purpose framework.
